subject.title: Mac app: native titlebar buttons fight the web UI (inconsistent highlight state, z-index, duplicated toolbar layout)

question: Should the macOS dashboard permanently move toolbar layout and interaction ownership into the Control UI, retaining only minimal native drag and history-state bridges?
rationale: This changes the long-term owner boundary between the macOS app and Control UI and defines the supported version-skew contract; tests alone cannot choose that product architecture.

options.title: Use web-owned toolbar
options.body: Review the linked PR as the canonical implementation, requiring native visual proof and bidirectional version-skew coverage before merge.

options.title: Keep native ownership
options.body: Close the linked PR and retain AppKit controls, but replace duplicated constants and CSS compensation with one explicit shared layout contract.

recommendation.title: Use web-owned toolbar
recommendation.body: Review the linked PR as the canonical implementation, requiring native visual proof and bidirectional version-skew coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged history and linked implementation show the strongest direct ownership of this titlebar architecture.
